subject: Request: Temporary Net-90 for HopeWorks pilot (funding cycle mismatch)
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta@hopeworks.org>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: HopeWorks Procurement <procurement@hopeworks.org>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary Net-90 for pilot due to grant timing

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the pilot conversation last week — we're excited to move forward. One constraint has come up on our side: our current fiscal grant disbursement will not arrive until the end of Q4, which effectively means we can only pay invoices on a ~90-day cadence for the next two quarters.

Would Redwood consider a temporary Net-90 invoicing cadence (quarterly invoicing) for the initial 6-month pilot? We can provide the grant schedule and a PO; we are a registered 501(c)(3) and the program is funded by a federal grant (I attached the SOW and the grant schedule).

If Net-90 is a hard no, please let us know alternative ways to bridge (e.g., prepay, escrow, or a short-term credit hold). We're eager to get the integration running in September.

Attachments: HopeWorks_SOW_Q3.pdf, GrantSchedule.xlsx

Best,
Marta Alvarez
Director of Operations
HopeWorks Foundation
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@hopeworks.org>
Cc: HopeWorks Procurement <procurement@hopeworks.org>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net-90 for pilot due to grant timing

Hi Marta — thanks for the clarity and for sending the SOW + schedule. I ran the ask by finance and deal desk and we need a short internal approval for Net-90 because it deviates from standard terms.

Proposed path from our side (what I'll escalate to finance/ops unless you prefer an alternate):
- Conditional Net-90 for a 6-month pilot only
- Redwood requires either: (A) a PO + an initial refundable deposit equal to one month of expected consumption, or (B) an irrevocable PO and a signed acknowledgement that payment will be made on the Net-90 schedule (we prefer A but will escalate B)
- No supplement to existing discounts (pilot will run on the quoted rates)
- Monthly usage report from HopeWorks to help us monitor billing cadence
- Auto-revert to standard Net-30 if payments are late or PO terms change

I'll put together a short memo and ask Finance (Laura), Deal Desk (Priyom) and Sales leadership (Jonas) for approval. If you can provide the formal PO and a contact for accounts payable (and the docuSign signature point), that'll speed things up.

I'll loop back within 48 hours.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary Net-90 for pilot due to grant timing

Jordan / Priyom — reviewed the HopeWorks billing history and the credit implications. Notes: nonprofit status reduces some risk but the grant timing creates a cashflow gap for us if invoices age 90 days. Recommended guardrails: 

1) Approve a 6-month pilot of Net-90 only if HopeWorks provides either: 25% prepayment of the first quarter invoice OR an irrevocable PO with AP contact and a confirmed funding date. The prepayment option is preferred for risk mitigation.
2) Add a one-time 2% processing fee to cover extended collection overhead (please add to the SOW as a line item).
3) Limit the pilot to the current SOW usage profile (cap at the expected monthly spend; any overages revert to prepay / standard terms).
4) Require monthly usage reports and a mid-pilot review at 90 days.

If these are acceptable, finance will approve and I'll prepare a short credit memo. If not, we should ask Legal to draft an irrevocable PO addendum and a late payment escalation clause.

I attached a brief credit memo template for your records.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary Net-90 for pilot due to grant timing

Team — I authorize a conditional exception for HopeWorks with the following final terms (aligns with Finance but loosens the prepay requirement to keep the pilot):

• Term: 6-month pilot, effective on first invoice date.
• Payment: Net-90, provided HopeWorks signs the PO and uploads proof of grant disbursement schedule. No prepayment required if we receive an irrevocable PO and an AP contact.
• Fee: waive the 2% processing fee for this nonprofit pilot (one-time executive concession).
• Cap & monitoring: cap the pilot to the expected monthly spend in the attached SOW; require monthly usage reports and a 90-day review.
• Remedies: if payment is >15 days late past Net-90, Redwood may put services into read-only and require immediate payment to restore full access.

This is a one-off concession — do not generalize across the segment. Priyom, please update the quote and finalize the DocuSign packet. Laura, finance should monitor cashflow and confirm when invoices are paid. Jordan, communicate the steps to Marta and collect the PO.

Jonas Weber
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@hopeworks.org>
Cc: HopeWorks Procurement <procurement@hopeworks.org>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net-90 for pilot due to grant timing — APPROVED (conditional)

Hi Marta — good news: Redwood has approved a conditional Net-90 pilot for HopeWorks. Summary of next steps and requirements (please confirm so we can schedule kickoff):

1) Sign the attached SOW (DocuSign link sent separately).
2) Provide the PO (HOPEWORKS_PO_4567.pdf) and AP contact. An irrevocable PO satisfies our finance condition so no prepayment is required.
3) Pilot is 6 months; invoices will be issued quarterly on Net-90 terms. We will cap usage at the SOW-expected monthly spend; overages billed at standard terms and due Net-30.
4) Monthly usage reports from HopeWorks; Redwood will conduct a 90-day review.
4) If payment is >15 days late past Net-90, Redwood may place the account into read-only.

We waived the one-time processing fee as an executive concession for this nonprofit pilot. This is a limited approval and will be re-evaluated at the end of the pilot.

Could you confirm the expected first invoice amount and upload the PO to the DocuSign packet by EOD next week? Once we have the PO uploaded we will finalize onboarding dates.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Attachments: HOPEWORKS_PO_4567.pdf (attachment stub)
